panels.title: Container Apps | System Events by App and Severity
panels.description: Counts real ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL records by selected-range time bucket, app, severity and event source. The log environment identifier is calmmushroom-4789bfc0, not ARM resource name incident-env. LastEventAt is the most recent actual event in each bucket. An empty selected range shows zero only when a matching system event was observed within one hour; otherwise Telemetry unavailable and a null count indicate unverified delivery. The independent seven-day evidence lookback does not add records to selected-range counts. Quiet system logs can lack a recent witness even when the platform is healthy; unavailable is not proof of failure. Query/permission/schema errors remain errors, never zero-filled. Raw messages are excluded.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Source = materialize(
    ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) or $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where EnvironmentName_s == 'calmmushroom-4789bfc0'
    | where isnotempty(ContainerAppName_s)
    | project TimeGenerated, ContainerAppName_s, Type_s, EventSource_s
);
let LastSourceEvent = toscalar(Source | summarize max(TimeGenerated));
let Selected = materialize(Source | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated));
let SelectedCount = toscalar(Selected | count);
union
    (Selected
    | summarize Events=count(), LastEventAt=max(TimeGenerated)
        by TimeGenerated=bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), ContainerAppName_s, Type_s, EventSource_s
    | extend Status='Observed events'),
    (print TimeGenerated=$__timeTo(), ContainerAppName_s='All monitored apps', Type_s='Not applicable',
        EventSource_s='ContainerAppSystemLogs_CL',
        Events=iff(isnotnull(LastSourceEvent) and LastSourceEvent >= ago(1h), long(0), long(null)),
        LastEventAt=LastSourceEvent,
        Status=iff(isnotnull(LastSourceEvent) and LastSourceEvent >= ago(1h),
            'Zero events in selected range', 'Telemetry unavailable')
    | where SelectedCount == 0)
| project TimeGenerated, Source=ContainerAppName_s, Severity=Type_s,
    EventSource=EventSource_s, Events, LastEventAt, Status
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: F. Container Scaling and Resource Utilization
Container Apps | Latest Reported Replicas
panels.description: Latest exported Replicas Maximum sample for ingestion, worker and dashboard within seven days. CurrentReplicas is shown only for samples no older than 15 minutes; stale or missing telemetry stays unknown. LastReportedReplicas and sample timestamp remain visible. This is not a seven-day peak or an instantaneous control-plane census.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Latest = AzureMetrics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResourceGroup =~ 'rg-incident-platform'
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.APP" and MetricName == "Replicas"
| where Resource in~ ("INCIDENT-INGESTION", "INCIDENT-WORKER", "INCIDENT-DASHBOARD")
| extend Resource=toupper(Resource)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Maximum) by Resource;
datatable(Resource:string)["INCIDENT-INGESTION", "INCIDENT-WORKER", "INCIDENT-DASHBOARD"]
| join kind=leftouter Latest on Resource
| project Resource, CurrentReplicas=iff(TimeGenerated >= ago(15m), toreal(Maximum), real(null)), LastReportedReplicas=toreal(Maximum), LastReportedAt=TimeGenerated, Freshness=case(isnull(TimeGenerated), "No sample; current unavailable", TimeGenerated < ago(15m), "Stale; current unavailable", "Recent metric sample")
| sort by Resource asc

panels.title: Coverage, semantics and cost
panels.description:
**Missing is not zero.** Gaps and query errors require investigation; system-event counts do not measure uptime or failures. Queue depth is not throughput; outgoing is broker delivery, not successful processing. Incoming/outgoing are observed totals, not unique events across stages.

Workbook summaries retain fixed seven-day filters and original formulas. Storage uses the Workbook division by 1024³ and rounding to three decimals (small real values can round to zero). The original consumed/provisioned-RU Workbook summary is retained with No data when empty. Actual consumed RU is queried separately from the existing metric API in hourly Total buckets; it is never replaced by NormalizedRUConsumption. Latest reported replicas are separate from seven-day peaks, and stale samples are not presented as current counts.

Manual refresh avoids background queries. Existing Analytics tables, identity, workspace, retention and Grafana hosting are reused; metric API usage and active hosting can still contribute to existing charges. No new instrumentation, resources, alerts or permissions.

**Preserved original panels:** panels 6 and 11–13 are restored verbatim except grid placement from the deployed dashboard/source 6a3c2085. The original guide’s five-minute refresh references describe the legacy dashboard; this consolidated dashboard uses manual refresh. The bars/donut are alternate views of the same queue totals, not additional unique events.

options.content:
**Missing is not zero.** Gaps and query errors require investigation; system-event counts do not measure uptime or failures. Queue depth is not throughput; outgoing is broker delivery, not successful processing. Incoming/outgoing are observed totals, not unique events across stages.

Workbook summaries retain fixed seven-day filters and original formulas. Storage uses the Workbook division by 1024³ and rounding to three decimals (small real values can round to zero). The original consumed/provisioned-RU Workbook summary is retained with No data when empty. Actual consumed RU is queried separately from the existing metric API in hourly Total buckets; it is never replaced by NormalizedRUConsumption. Latest reported replicas are separate from seven-day peaks, and stale samples are not presented as current counts.

Manual refresh avoids background queries. Existing Analytics tables, identity, workspace, retention and Grafana hosting are reused; metric API usage and active hosting can still contribute to existing charges. No new instrumentation, resources, alerts or permissions.

**Preserved original panels:** panels 6 and 11–13 are restored verbatim except grid placement from the deployed dashboard/source 6a3c2085. The original guide’s five-minute refresh references describe the legacy dashboard; this consolidated dashboard uses manual refresh. The bars/donut are alternate views of the same queue totals, not additional unique events.

**Depth is not throughput.** Active and dead-lettered panels show average point-in-time queue depth. Flat zero can mean no traffic or messages consumed between samples. A flat nonzero DLQ can be retained messages; it is not a count of new failures. Use incoming/outgoing totals alongside depth.

**Missing is not zero.** Gaps, No data, or query errors can mean absent telemetry, ingestion delay, wrong time range, or missing access. Check the last 6 hours, expand to 24 hours if needed, and inspect errors. Nulls are not connected or filled with zeros.

**Container Apps:** system-event counts come from existing workspace logs. They do not prove readiness or uptime. Raw messages, synthetic traffic, new diagnostics and alert rules are not included. Managed-identity log-query access requires a Grafana runtime smoke check.

**Cost:** 5-minute refresh; existing resources only. Grafana may scale to zero, so the first load can be slow. Log queries may incur existing workspace query charges depending on the table plan.

**Overview analytics:** traffic cards/bars sum observed Azure Total buckets separately for each queue over the selected range. These are partial subtotals if telemetry is missing, not lifetime totals or unique incidents across pipeline stages. Count > 0 filtering suppresses empty/all-null totals; observed zero stays zero. Depth cards use the last reported interval Average, which may be stale; inspect time-series timestamps and gaps.

**Circular indicator:** the donut compares only observed incoming traffic by queue. Zero traffic has no meaningful share; missing telemetry means incomplete coverage. No capacity, utilization, or failure percentage is inferred. Gauges are omitted because no verified limit/threshold exists.

**Query cost:** added summary panels reuse the same metric definitions but issue additional read-only metric queries; refresh remains five minutes. No new log query or resource is introduced.

description: Existing Azure Monitor metrics, Workbook KQL and Resource Graph queries. Manual refresh; missing data is never treated as zero. Workbook summaries retain their fixed seven-day window.
